2001 *uddrāti 'flees, flies'. [Cf. uddrāvá- 'running away' VS., m. 'going upwards' Pāṇ.: √drā]
    Kt. vudra-, (Bagromatal) undra- 'to fly' (Rep¹ 60 and NTS xii 154 suggests connexion with uḍḍīyatē); L. (Jukes) uḍraṇ 'to fly' (beside uḍ̠aṇ < uḍḍīyatē. — Poss. further development in Dm. undrä̃ŕ- 'to fly', L. uddrãṛaṇ. — With -kk-: S. uḍ̠ako, uḍ̠iko m. 'fear'.
